selected_evidence.summary: Node2 downloaded both files; downloaded SHA-256 hashes match node1's sources. The final server check shows the intended secure root, active UDP/69 listener, SELinux labels, and read-only modes.

selected_evidence.requirement: Reject uploads and requests outside the boot root
selected_evidence.summary: New uploads, overwrite attempts, and ../private traversal returned TFTP errors before and after restarts. Unauthorized targets remain absent and approved file hashes are unchanged.
